pages.text: Place and open this table to edit a spell. Insert a typed or saved core in the top-right slot. See the $(l:modularmagic:tutorial)walkthrough$(/l).
Shapeless crafting table and book and quill recipe.

pages.title: Saving and extraction
pages.text: Apply commits edits; Take core extracts the assembly. Closing saves pending parameters and keeps the core inside across world reloads.$(br2)One player can edit a table at a time. Breaking it drops its stored core.
